# Release surface for nightly-next promotions (scripts/ci/promote-nightly-next.mjs).
#
# A promotion whose range changes a file matched here waits for an approval in
# the release-surface-ack environment. List every repository file that a job
# holding nightly-next signing, notarization or publishing secrets runs or
# reads, plus the gate that admits a promotion. `**` matches across
# directories, `*` within one. The guard reads this file from main.
#
# Policy line. `@require_non_lander_approver on` makes the guard refuse an
# approval by anyone who landed a surface-changing commit of the range or
# started the run. Off: any approval in release-surface-ack counts.
@require_non_lander_approver off
